newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean 3-yr yields close at 18-month high.
newsitem.headline: South Korean 3-yr yields close at 18-month high.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporate bonds closed at a 18-month high on Tuesday as tightening liquidity dampened buying sentiment, brokers said.
The three-month CDs and the overnight call rates edged up due to rising money demand in the short-term money market, they said.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.75 pct from 12.65 on Monday
* 3-mth CDs close at 13.20 pct from 13.10 pct
The three-month CDs and the overnight call rates crept higher on the back of rising money demand in the short-term money market.
New issues for the three-year corporates were estimated at 31.6 billion won today. On Wednesday, they are estimated at 303 billion won.
